title: Newhalo footer
description: A black footer panel inset 6–10px from the window edge with 8px corners. As it scrolls in it clips from a full-bleed rectangle into the inset panel, the link columns fade in and the wide art strip rises 60px. Three link columns with 28px headings top left, an outlined and an orange button top right, legal links and copyright in 12px along the bottom; on phones it all stacks with a square art slot.
notes: the art slot held a fine line drawing of the product in the original
